test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If you deposit Rs. 6,000 in a bank with 4% per year simple interest for 7 years then the simple interest received will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹6,000

Rate (r) = 4% per year

Time (t) = 7 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times r times t}{100}

**Calculation:**

SI = dfrac{6000 times 4 times 7}{100}

⇒ SI = dfrac{168000}{100}

⇒ SI = ₹1680

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
